topic: VTE risk assessment in psychiatric inpatients

audits.title: An Audit on Venous Thromboembolism Risk Assessment in Older Persons Mental Health Inpatient Unit in North Wales With the Aim of a Quality Improvement Project
audits.standard: NICE and Department of Health VTE guidance; target 100% compliance
audits.setting: Older persons mental health inpatient units, 3 sites, Betsi Cadwaladr University Health Board, North Wales

cycle1.result: East: 6/9 forms filled; Central: 2 of 21 patients had a form, none filled; West: 3/11 had a filled form. No standard proforma in Central and West.

audits.other_findings: VTE prophylaxis was inconsistently noted on medication charts; a trust-wide VTE risk assessment proforma adapted for psychiatry was recommended.
audits.citation: Soundararajan S, Dhandapani A, Wallis F, Bhalerao M. An Audit on Venous Thromboembolism Risk Assessment in Older Persons Mental Health Inpatient Unit in North Wales With the Aim of a Quality Improvement Project. BJPsych Open. 2023;9(Suppl 1):S11-S11.

audits.title: An Audit of Venous Thromboembolism (VTE) Risk Assessment in an NHS Trust Mental Health Inpatient Setting
audits.standard: NICE NG89: VTE risk assessment on admission or first consultant review, reassessment, and prophylaxis where indicated
audits.setting: 23 inpatient wards, Black Country Healthcare NHS Foundation Trust

cycle1.result: 30 (59.2%) risk assessed within 24 hours; 2% reassessed during admission; all 3 at-risk patients (6.1%) given prophylaxis but none reassessed for continued need.

audits.other_findings: Recommended VTE teaching at junior doctor induction and a Trust VTE policy including mental health risk factors.
audits.citation: Atmakur M, Ibrahim S, Adedipe O. An Audit of Venous Thromboembolism (VTE) Risk Assessment in an NHS Trust Mental Health Inpatient Setting. BJPsych Open. 2024;10(S1):S239-S239. doi:10.1192/bjo.2024.583.

audits.title: Venous Thromboembolism (VTE) Risk Assessments in Psychiatric Inpatients Audit
audits.standard: NICE VTE in over-16s guideline: risk assessment on admission or by first consultant review, and reassessment at consultant review
audits.setting: 16 inpatient wards, Coventry and Warwickshire Partnership NHS Trust

cycle1.result: 153 (63%) had a signed and dated VTE assessment on admission; 154 (63%) within 24 hours; 242 (99%) had no reassessment at consultant review.

audits.other_findings: 13 (5%) assessments unsigned or undated; recommended induction teaching and making the VTE section a required field.
audits.citation: Kanabar R, Onyeanuforo C, Kusi A, Shakeel S. Venous Thromboembolism (VTE) Risk Assessments in Psychiatric Inpatients Audit. BJPsych Open. 2025;11(S1):S249-S250. doi:10.1192/bjo.2025.10617.

audits.title: Venous Thromboembolism Risk Assessment Audit
audits.standard: Trust policy and Department of Health VTE risk assessment guidance
audits.setting: Four acute psychiatric wards, St Ann's Hospital and Chase Farm Hospital (North London NHS Foundation Trust)

cycle1.result: VTE risk assessment done in 0/40 admissions.

audits.other_findings: Action plan: present at induction, share with consultants, nurses to check VTE assessment at clerking, and re-audit in 12 months.

audits.title: To Determine if Patients on Birkdale Ward Are Assessed for Risk of Venous Thromboembolism in Compliance With the Trust’s Standard Operating Procedure
audits.standard: Trust standard operating procedure for prevention and management of VTE (August 2023) and NICE guidance that all admitted patients have a VTE risk assessment
audits.setting: Birkdale Ward, secure inpatient unit, Mersey Care NHS Trust

cycle1.result: Overall compliance 0%; 68% appropriately assessed at all trigger points, 38% required an up-to-date VTE assessment

audits.intervention: All patients needing an assessment received one and the SOP was disseminated to ward staff; SOP to be amended before re-audit
audits.other_findings: The audit tool was adapted for long secure admissions and a defined data collection time frame was needed. Concerns were raised about the applicability of the SOP in acute and secure settings.
audits.citation: Dandawate A. To Determine if Patients on Birkdale Ward Are Assessed for Risk of Venous Thromboembolism in Compliance With the Trust’s Standard Operating Procedure. BJPsych Open. 2025;11(Suppl 1):S225-S226.

audits.title: Venous Thromboembolism (VTE) Risk Assessment in Acute Inpatient Mental Health Wards in Sherwood Oaks and Millbrook Unit (now Blossomwood Unit), Nottinghamshire Healthcare NHS Foundation Trust
audits.standard: Trust policy 02.21: VTE risk assessment within 24 hours of admission; NICE NG89 (stated as NG82) 2019: assess all acute psychiatric patients as soon as possible after admission or by first consultant review
audits.setting: 8 acute inpatient mental health wards, Sherwood Oaks and Millbrook Unit, Nottinghamshire Healthcare NHS Foundation Trust

cycle1.result: 69.3% assessed on admission (50% within 24 hours); 30.7% not assessed during admission

audits.other_findings: Using Wells scoring, all assessed patients in cycle 2 were low risk (80.5%), with 19.5% of unknown risk because they were not assessed.
audits.citation: Omesili C, Bashir F. Venous Thromboembolism (VTE) Risk Assessment in Acute Inpatient Mental Health Wards in Sherwood Oaks and Millbrook Unit (now Blossomwood Unit), Nottinghamshire Healthcare NHS Foundation Trust. BJPsych Open. 2025;11(Suppl 1):S265-S266.
